title: Heart of the Hollow
summary: Master Thornroot's pressure, then carry your finished Beta build through the Hollow's Final Trial.

chain.title: Chapter III — Heart of Shenic
chain.description: Refine your chosen identity through Twilight and the Old Forest, then clear the Hollow's Final Trial.
chain.goal: Reach level 30, master Thornroot Hollow, and clear Forgotten Catacombs I.
chain.promisedReward: Choose a fourth guaranteed Essence and complete the focused Beta journey.

choice.selectionSummary: Choose the Essence that completes your four-slot Beta build or opens a future experiment.
choice.confirmationText: This Essence will be awarded when you complete the focused Beta journey.

options.title: Claim the Glade Panther Essence
options.summary: A physical burst option that brings increased critical chance and critical damage.

options.title: Claim the Forest Spirit Essence
options.summary: A dedicated sustain option that repeatedly heals the weakest ally and rewards healing-focused builds.

options.title: Claim the Blackjaw Spider Essence
options.summary: A physical execution option that punishes wounded targets and periodically pierces armor.

objectives.description: Master Thornroot's pressure: win 6 encounters in Thornroot Hollow.
Clear the Hollow's Final Trial: complete Forgotten Catacombs I and defeat its boss.
